title: C#/XAML Dependency Graph repository profile
description: The conventions one workspace folder declares, stored at <workspace folder>/csharp-xaml-graph.profile.json. Every section and every key inside it is optional: an absent key keeps the extension's built-in value, and a present array replaces the built-in array rather than extending it. Keys this schema does not name are reported to the reader and otherwise ignored, never fatal.

version.description: Format version. A profile without this, or with any other value, is unusable and nothing is written.

repository.description: Which repository this describes. Informational only: it is never used to match a folder or gate a run.

layers.description: Layer classification. Rules are evaluated in order and the first that matches decides, which is how precedence is declared.

default.description: Layer for a type no rule matches. Built-in value is model.

links.description: Link detection. Each key names the calls or casts that draw a dependency, and each maps to one branch of the analysis.

genericPairCalls.description: Method names called as x.Call<TA, TB>(): draws a resolves edge from the second type to the first and registers both.

typeofPairCalls.description: Method names called as x.Call(typeof(TA), typeof(TB)): draws a resolves edge and registers the first type.

dependencyPropertyCall.description: Method name called as x.Call(nameof(P), typeof(TValue), typeof(TOwner)): draws a getservice edge when the value type is a view model by the layers rules.

addCallPattern.description: Regular expression a registration method name matches. One type argument registers that type; two pair an implementation with the interface it serves.

serviceLocator.description: Method names that read a service from the container rather than being a plain call.

dataContextCasts.description: Cast keywords that, applied to the data context with an interface type, draw a binding edge. Built-in value is is and as.

findings.description: Rules that change what the cleanup report counts or reports.

entryPoints.description: Type names that are never reported unused.

transparentBases.description: Base type names that add no bindable members, so a missing member is genuinely missing.

files.description: Which files are read. An explicitly configured csharpXamlGraph.include or csharpXamlGraph.exclude wins over this section, pattern by pattern.

include.description: Glob patterns, relative to the workspace folder, describing the files to read.

exclude.description: Glob patterns excluded from the read.

layerRule.description: One layer rule. Every condition it states must hold for it to match; a rule with no condition matches any type.

layer.description: Layer assigned when the rule matches.

kinds.description: Declaration kinds the rule applies to. Absent means any kind.

nameSuffixes.description: The type name ends with one of these.

namePrefixes.description: The type name starts with one of these.

namespaceSegments.description: The namespace has a segment exactly equal to one of these. Whole segments only: a substring test for Models also matches ViewModels.

unlessNameSuffixes.description: The rule does not apply when the name ends with one of these, which is how a row model beside the view models stays a model.

generatedMembersRule.description: Members the compiler generates from an attribute, so a binding to one is not a dead binding.

attribute.description: Attribute name without brackets, for example RelayCommand.

form.description: How the generated member is named. commandSuffix yields NameCommand and, for a name ending in Async, StemCommand. pascalCaseWithoutPrefix strips leading underscores and upper-cases the first letter.
